wiktionary.format: Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL; deprecated upstream, not raw Wiktextract data
wiktionary.modifications: Retain 3–11-letter lexical headwords with Zipf >=2.5, English glosses, tags and form/alternative relationships. Exclude proper-name POS and explicitly other-country labelled senses. Preserve original spelling and record hashes. Exclude punctuation, spaces and unsupported characters. Omit enrichment, audio, examples, quotations, translations and etymology. No exact article revision is supplied. Regional source labels are incomplete.

wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.modifications: Exact NFC uppercase spelling frequencies, taking maximum across case variants, never adding them. No accent aliases in frequency evidence. Historical mixed-corpus spelling frequency, not individual-sense or exclusive regional frequency.
